2. Short facts as disclosed in the plaint arc that the suit schedule Nos. 1-3, measuring an area of 2.72 acres, originally belonged to one Prasanna Kaman Dasi who, transferred the same by a deed dated 14th June, 1919 in favour of Zogendra Lal Das and Mohendra lal Das. They mutated their names in R.S. khatian in equal shares. Mohendra lal Das got 1.36 acres in his share who transferred .80 acre in favour of his wife Josoda Kumari by kabala dated 13th November, 1928. Josoda Kumari while enjoying right, title and possession died leaving the plaintiff as only son to inherit her property. As the plaintiff was staying at different places in connection with his service, he failed to attend during B.S. survey at home. Taking advantage of his absence, the defendants managed to record their names, which clouded his title in the suit land. Mohendra Lal Das transferred to his wife Josoda Kumari, .80 acre keeping only .56 acre, which he transferred in favour of defendant Nos.2-14 by different deeds. Plaintiff and his predecessors did never transfer any property. Principal defendants by practicing fraud managed to record suit land in their names in B.S. Khatian beyond plaintiffs knowledge. 

 3. Case of the defendant No.1 is that he is the son of Sarin Bala, a sister of Jogendra Lal Das and Mohendra Lal Das. She was married to Zudhistir who died when he was a child. Sarju Bala was brought with him to her paternal house by her brothers and gave her shelter by constructing a house over R.S. Plot No.1821. Subsequently Jogendra transferred his share to his wife Sudha Rani on 14th February, 1953 by way of a gift. Mohendra and Sudha Rani executed deeds dated 14th October, 1956 giving permission to enjoy .0712 acre of land to Sarju Bala and then orally gifted her (Sarju Bala) another .0512 acre of land. After the death of Sarju Bala her son, this defendant No.1 being the only heir has been enjoying .13 acre of the suit land, which land was recorded in B.S. khatian in his name. Mohendra Lal Das filed an objection Case No.476 dated 17th August, 1876 against this recording but it was rejected.
